comment: restore.c dorecover() 930 run_timers(): "expire all timers that have gone off while away". A debug Valkyrie wishes for speed boots, an ice box (it drops to the floor) and a gecko corpse, wears the boots and searches until the corpse is about 248 turns old. She stashes it in the ice box and takes it out again; mkobj.c start_corpse_timeout() gives it ROT_AGE - age + rnz(10) - 10 turns, which this draw makes zero or less, so its ROT_CORPSE timer is already due. Speed boots give her a second action in that turn, so she saves before nh_timeout() runs it. The second segment restores: C's dorecover() runs the due timer before docrt(), so "Your gecko corpse rots away." precedes the welcome-back message and the corpse is gone when she lists her inventory; she then searches once. Seeds, datetimes, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
